tree.notes: Spider body reduced to a 3-node spine (root/pedicel -> abdomen tip and root -> cephalothorax -> head), since no external tail is present (per leaf rules abdomen is body mass, not a counted leaf). All 8 legs are modeled with the same 4-segment scheme (coxa -> patella -> tibia -> tarsus[leaf]) though the source mesh shows more subtle bends; the multi-joint split and the equal-thirds-style length partition per leg are anatomical inferences, not direct grid readings, since only overall hip-to-foot span could be measured reliably from the three views. Each leg's segments were all given the same direction vector (straight-line simplification) because intermediate joint coordinates could not be independently distinguished in the render; only the net hip->foot displacement (from top view x/z and side/front view y) was used to fix direction. Left/right legs of each of the 4 pairs are exact mirror copies (same lengths, z-component negated) per the symmetric-pair rule, even though the rendered pose (e.g. the lifted rear leg) is asymmetric - lengths were authored from the pose-averaged proportion, not the specific pose. Pair numbering runs front-to-back (pair1 nearest head, pair4 nearest pedicel), matching the four visible leg clusters in the top-down view.
